themes.theme: Proposed Ban on Berried Lobster and Crawfish
themes.reason: This defines the core implementation mechanism itself: the specific legal method chosen (amending existing SI under the Sea Fish Conservation Act), its scope, and which vessels/waters it applies to. Without this, there is no description of how the intervention is actually to be delivered.

This explains the process by which the delivery method and underlying assumptions will be tested and finalised, addressing the should-explain point about how the method is being decided where still open.

This describes how the ban will be enforced and implemented in practice (testing kits, routine inspections, building on existing procedures), directly addressing how the intervention will be rolled out.

This provides the detailed cost estimates and assumptions for implementation, addressing the should-explain point on costs and benefits, but is a supporting quantification rather than the argument's structural basis.
This is a minor, unquantified side-benefit for certain IFCAs and does not carry the main implementation argument.
A brief remark about simplification benefits of using existing legislation, supporting but not essential to the implementation case.
A passing restatement of the same simplification point as Legislative Framework, not a distinct supporting pillar.
